title: elm-foldbook: a multidimensional spreadsheet prototype with mathematical documents for teaching and research in corporate finance

creators.name: Erzegovesi, Luca
creators.affiliation: Department of Economics and Management, University of Trento

description:
Research prototype of a browser-based multidimensional spreadsheet written in Elm. Datasets with named dimensions are edited in a pivot-style grid, array-level formulas are written in Elm and evaluated by an extended elm-interpreter, and documents in elm-markup combine text, MathLive equations and live spreadsheets. elm-foldbook is the pilot of the Impromptu project.

Developed June-December 2024. Version 0.7 dates from 16 December 2024 (git tag v0.7). The code was made public in 2026: release 0.7.1 adds packaging (calculation engine vendored, licenses) and release 0.7.2 an updated README; the application source is unchanged from v0.7.
notes: Developed June-December 2024; version 0.7 of 16 December 2024; made public in 2026. This archive is git tag v0.7.2 of https://github.com/lerzegov/elm-foldbook.
